purpose: Neutral expressions, male toki, position-dependent interaction poses

prompts.codex:
Production transparent desktop mascot SPRITE ATLAS. Wide 3:1 canvas 3072x1024. EXACTLY THREE isolated instances of the SAME character in ONE ROW of THREE EQUAL SQUARE CELLS, ordered left to right. Each cell is 1024x1024. Every pose must fit inside central 60% of its own cell with at least 180px transparent padding on left and right. HUGE EMPTY TRANSPARENT GAPS BETWEEN FIGURES, no overlap, no crossing cells, no cropped hair. TOKI IS A BOY / MALE older brother: tousled SHORT black hair, black cat ears, gray-green half-lidded eyes, black casual jacket over a plain white T-SHIRT, BLACK TROUSERS and simple sneakers. Subtle mint zipper accent. Absolutely NO dress, skirt, frills, hair ribbons, maid outfit or bare legs. The BOY on the LEFT of reference 1 is his identity; exclude the girl.
Reference 2 is ONLY the required facial expression and simplified cute drawing style: neutral deadpan, droopy HALF-LIDDED eyes with thick STRAIGHT horizontal upper eyelids, small calm pupils, tiny flat straight closed mouth or no visible mouth. NO SMILE at all in ANY POSE, no curved-up lips, no open mouth, no cheerful eyes, no exuberance, no blush smile. Calm slightly sleepy / unimpressed face EXACTLY the mood of reference 2. Keep the identity from reference 1 but simplify into clean flat chibi illustration with thick navy outlines, large head and tiny body like reference 2.
LEFT CELL: SIDE-EDGE PEEK pose. Character upright, both hands gripping an IMAGINARY VERTICAL screen edge on the RIGHT side of the body at chest and waist height. Head and shoulders lean out to the LEFT, looking toward viewer with deadpan eyes. Show head, upper torso and tiny lower body only. The hands are the rightmost points of the silhouette. Do NOT draw any edge, frame, wall or line.
MIDDLE CELL: BOTTOM-EDGE PEEK pose. Front view head and upper torso with two little hands resting flat on an IMAGINARY HORIZONTAL screen bottom ledge, palms/fingers visible at the LOWEST edge of the silhouette, head ABOVE hands. No legs shown in this pose. Do NOT draw a ledge.
RIGHT CELL: TOP-EDGE HANG pose. Both arms reach UP, two hands grip an IMAGINARY horizontal ledge ABOVE the head, head and small body hang DOWN underneath, legs hanging in a relaxed way. Hands must be highest points, no upside-down person, no rotated head. Do NOT draw a ledge. Fully clothed.
All three repeat exactly the same neutral face and identity. This atlas will be cut into equal thirds, so each complete figure needs independent transparent padding. No text, labels, grids, borders, background, shadow, smoke, glow or objects. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA PNG.
